description: Use this to run an autonomous build INSIDE Claude Code from an architect's committed spec + plans — no external kernel, no multi-account pool. You are the main session that drives the whole build: compute dependency-ready tasks, dispatch a fresh subagent per task (test-first), re-run each gate yourself, scope-check and review the diff, then commit. Trigger it when the user says "build this", "run the build", "execute the plan/manifest", "orchestrate the build", or hands you an architect's plans/manifest and asks you to build the project. This is the Claude-Code-native replacement for the deterministic kernel: you play kernel + reviewer, and Claude Code subagents play the executor pool. Do NOT use it to plan (that's the architect) or to write product code yourself (dispatch it).
